item.description: JAMMU: Northern Army Commander Lt Gen Pratik Sharma has reviewed security measures aimed at strengthening the counter-terrorism framework at a joint meeting in Jammu and Kashmir’s Udhampur district, officials said on Friday. The opposition members were also protesting against the India-US interim trade agreement.
